Void.use: Primary dark. Backgrounds, one-color marks, text on light

Ion.use: O-class accent for links, UI and text on light (5.9:1 on Paper). Not a logo color

Ember.use: M-class accent for warnings and highlights on light (4.7:1 on Paper). Not a logo color

cone.profiles: Standard nose-cone equations (conical, tangent ogive, elliptical, LD-Haack/Von Karman C = 0)

mark.spacing_rule: Diamond, measured on a grid leaned 45 deg (lay out upright, then rotate the whole cluster). r = Von Karman base radius. Each foot is cut flat, parallel to the base, where the wall between flank and notch is FOOT_K x its base radius wide. With the lean at 0 the Von Karman is north and the ogive is the tail, south on the same axis, with its tip +0.21 r from the Von Karman foot line (+ = below). The area centroids of the conical (west) and elliptical (east) wings share a line +0.47 r from the Von Karman foot line. The west wing's inner foot corner is 0.19 r from the left Von Karman foot corner and the east wing's is 0.23 r from the right one (horizontal gaps)

lockups.horizontal: mark before the wordmark, mark height 1.917 x cap height, gap 0.35 x cap height (0.183 x mark height)
lockups.stacked: mark above the wordmark, cluster height H, gap 0.100 H to the cap line, wordmark width 4.29 H

two_tone.rule: Each cone takes the gradient end nearest its own position in the sweep
two_tone.note: One cone pair on every background; only the wordmark flips

mark.small_size: On light backgrounds, a horizontal lockup under 32 px tall uses the one-color Void lockup (`fusion-space-horizontal-void`): at that size the thin gradient details are too faint on light.

production.note: The DXF trims each foot so the wall is at least dxf_min_foot_wall_mm wide and scales the trimmed outline to dxf_height_mm tall; otherwise it matches the master outline. Tips are true points.

mark.units: r = Von Karman base radius. u, v are on the leaned grid, from the Von Karman base center, v down (toward the bases).

gradient_note: One gradient for every background, always left to right. WCAG 2 contrast of every stop: about 3.0:1 on white, 6.3:1 on Void, 2.8:1 on Paper (accepted; the target was white).

M orange.use: Warm accent on dark: labels, warnings (6.3:1 on Void)

O blue.use: Cool accent on dark: labels, links, taglines (6.3:1 on Void)

spectral_note: O and M are the Fusion gradient ends: the O- and M-class star colors, deepened on October 2, 2026 so the whole gradient holds at least 3:1 on white. B to K are the star colors sampled from the Harvard classification.
